title: For any ringed site with independent universes and its sheafification hypotheses, a quasi-isomorphism from a bounded finite-free-retract complex E on C/U to K restricted to U induces an actual quasi-isomorphism from Hom(E,O_U[0]) to the restriction of the fixed global complex I(Hom(K,I(O[0])))
statement: For any ringed site with independent universes and its sheafification hypotheses, a quasi-isomorphism from a bounded finite-free-retract complex E on C/U to K restricted to U induces an actual quasi-isomorphism from Hom(E,O_U[0]) to the restriction of the fixed global complex I(Hom(K,I(O[0]))). Only the map is asserted; boundedness and the finite-free retractions of its source are a separate result.

proof.text: Hom from each finite-free-retract term is exact, as a retract of a finite sum. Bounded exact-source Hom therefore sends the unit augmentation to a quasi-isomorphism, identifying the ordinary local dual with local derived Hom.

Apply exact derived restriction and its Hom comparison. The localization of the given quasi-isomorphism identifies E with the restricted K, and restriction of the unit identifies the coefficient targets. The fixed Hom factorization and outer augmentation identify the restricted global model with that local derived Hom.

The outer replacement is K-injective. Its restriction remains K-injective by the exact extension-by-zero adjunction. Lift the resulting derived isomorphism to a chain map by the K-injective Hom equivalence. Since localization inverts this map, it is a quasi-isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedSitePerfectDual_localComparison
    {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [∀ U : C, HasSheafify (J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [∀ U : C, (J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{max c v r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R))]
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (U : C)
    (E : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r} (((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R).over U)) ℤ)
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (E.X n))
    (pkg : SheafOfModules.StrictPerfectCoefficientPackageOnSite _ E)
    (α : E ⟶ ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ U).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) (hα : QuasiIso α) :
    ∃ β : homComplex (R := R.over U) E
        (ringedSiteDualityUnitComplex.{max c v, v, r} (J.over U) (R.over U)) ⟶
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ U).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        ((WeilConjectures.coefficientHomResolution.{r, c, v} J R).obj
          (homComplex (R := R) K
            ((WeilConjectures.coefficientHomResolution.{r, c, v} J R).obj
              (ringedSiteDualityUnitComplex.{c, v, r} J R)))), QuasiIso β
